integrity: Exact Fourier coefficients, monotone conductor ratios, endpoint strictness, Haar-mode loss, finite quotient nullities and first-order finite-resolution correction are supported by a written analytical proof and reproducible supplementary checks.
scientific_limitations: Sharpness is proved for compact additive p-adic integers, ordinary real exponential-distance profiles, nonnegative subtraction, and canonical coset-averaged finite quotients only. The finite checker supports but does not replace the infinite proof; historical priority is best-knowledge and not independently audited.
title: A sharp multiresolution positivity switch for signed ultrametric exponential kernels
